fallback_policy.note: Primary English is the project fallback when a listing translation is unavailable, not a guarantee of Apple storefront selection. Apple chooses display metadata using its localization rules. Fallback or copied English is never completed translation.
fallback_policy.app_note: Listing-only locales do not add app UI languages. English is the documented project fallback for these locales, subject to device language preferences; device behavior must be verified.
